entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of that beloved shining star Muhammad, when he descended from Mi'raaj (i.e. the Ascension).
Your companion (i.e. the Beloved Prophet Muhammad) has not strayed, nor was he misled.
And he does not say anything of his own desire.
It is not but revelation which is sent down upon him.
The One Who is extremely Mighty, the Powerful has taught him.
Then that Manifestation intended.
And he (i.e. the Beloved Prophet Muhammad) was on the horizon of the uppermost heaven.
Then that Manifestation came closer, and then He became increasingly closer (towards His Beloved).
So, the distance remaining between that Manifestation and this Beloved was only of two arms length; rather, even less.
Now He revealed to His bondsman whatever He revealed.
The heart (of the Prophet Muhammad) did not lie regarding what he saw.
So, do you dispute with him regarding what he saw (on the night of Mi'raaj)?
And he did see that Manifestation two times.
Near the Lote Tree of the furthest boundary.
Close to which is Jannah Al-Ma'wa.
When the Lote Tree was being enveloped with whatever was covering it (i.e. a supreme decoration of marvellous lights and angels).
The eyes (of the Beloved Prophet) did not turn aside nor exceed the limit.
Indeed, he saw the greatest signs of his Lord.
So, did you (O polytheists) observe (the false deities) Laat and 'Uzza?
And subsequently the third one, Manaat?
(Is there fairness in your saying) for you a son and for Him a daughter?
Then that is a very pathetic division.

They are nothing but some names that you and your forefathers have devised. Allah has not sent any proof for them; they (the polytheists) follow only speculations and the desires of their baser-selves. Whereas, indeed the guidance from their Lord has come to them.
Will man acquire whatever he wishes?
So, only Allah is the Owner of all; the Hereafter and this world.
And how many angels are in the heavens, that their intercession does not benefit the least but when Allah gives permission for whomsoever He wills and chooses (i.e. then intercession will benefit).
Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels female names.
And they do not have any knowledge of it; they merely follow assumptions. And indeed, assumption does not serve any purpose in place of certainty.
Therefore, turn your face away from the one who has turned away from Our remembrance, and he has desired not but the worldly life.
Up to this is the extent of their knowledge. Indeed, your Lord knows well the one who has strayed from His path, and He knows well the one who has attained guidance.

And only to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, in order to recompense those who do evil for what they have done and give an excellent reward to those who do good deeds.

Those who avoid the major sins and indecencies, except that they approached sin and refrained. Indeed, the forgiveness of your Lord is very vast; He knows you well; He has created you from clay and when you were foetuses in your mother's wombs, therefore do not make the claim of yourselves to be pure. He knows well who are the pious.
So, did you see the one who turned away?
And he gave little and held back.
Does he have the knowledge of the unseen by means of which he can observe?
Or has the news not come to him, which is mentioned in the Scriptures of Moosa?
And (mentioned in the Scrolls) of Ibrahim, who obeyed the orders completely.
(The fact is this) that no burdened soul bears the burden of another soul.
And this; that man shall attain nothing but what he strove for (i.e. of good or bad).
And this; that his effort will soon be examined.
Then he will be fully recompensed for it.
And this; that the end (of every creation) is only towards your Lord.
And this; that it is He Who caused laughter and weeping.
And this; that it is He Who caused death and gave life.
And this; that it is He Who has created the two kinds; male and female.
From a semen-drop when it is emitted (into the womb).
And this; that only upon His responsibility is the second creation (i.e. bringing back to life after death).
And this; that only He has given wealth and contentment.
And this; that only He is the Lord of the star named Shi'ra (Sirius).
And this; that it is He Who destroyed first the (tribe of) 'Aad?
And the (tribe of) Thamood, so He spared none.
And before them (destroyed) the people of Nooh; indeed, they were more unjust and more rebellious than them (the tribes of 'Aad and Thamood).
And He caused the throwing down of the overturned town (of the people of Loot).
Hence, covered it whatever covered (i.e. the terrible rain of marked stones).
So, O listener! Which of your favours of your Lord will you doubt?
This (i.e. the Beloved Prophet Muhammad) is a warner, like the former warners.
The approaching one (i.e. the Day of Judgement) has come near.
There is no one except Allah to disclose it (i.e. the Day of Judgement).
So, are you surprised at this fact (that the Qur'aan is revealed upon a human being)?
And you laugh and do not weep.
And you are indulged in play.
Thus, prostrate to Allah, and worship Him.
